scope: explanatory metadata only; reproducibility/v2/r3r2/gate.json is unchanged

candidate_level_competence.position_pass: position RMSE below the frozen threshold for each listed candidate
candidate_level_competence.ramp_pass: ramp peak and/or steady-state condition passes for each listed candidate
candidate_level_competence.realtime_pass: P95 solve time below the frozen runtime limit for each listed candidate

final_selected_candidate_eligibility.reason: All Stage-2 candidates failed the frozen global acquisition and common-success paired acquisition thresholds; no candidate was eligible for selection.

interpretation: The false selected-candidate gate fields in gate.json encode final eligibility with selected_candidate=null; they do not mean that every raw candidate-level safety, solver, steady, success, position, ramp, and realtime check failed.
scientific_conclusion: DR-TSRMPC showed a partial advantage over the traditional envelope in success, position, and ramp metrics, but did not satisfy the simultaneous acquisition requirements and is not a V2 Self-Advanced winner.
